test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The scores of four cricket players are as follows:

Mohan scored more than Narender but less than Pankaj. Kamal scored more than Narender but less than Mohan.

Who scored the highest?
solution:
Given: Four cricket players

Mohan scored more than Narender but less than Pankaj.

Pankaj > Mohan > Narender

Kamal scored more than Narender but less than Mohan.

Pankaj > Mohan > Kamal > Narender

So, '**Pankaj**' scored the highest run.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
